# Magnevents Artist Portal

> Magnevents Artist Portal (https://artists.magnevents.in) is the official onboarding, profile management, and direct booking management portal for live musicians, singers, bands, DJs, anchors, and performers across India.

## Purpose & Overview
The Magnevents Artist Portal empowers artists to:
- Create and maintain a verified public artist profile on https://www.magnevents.in/artists.
- Set upfront performance pricing (solo, duo, full band, hourly, and outstation rates).
- Upload live performance videos, YouTube showreels, and verified repertoire.
- Complete government-verified identity and KYC checks for trusted booking.
- Manage calendar availability (block dates, mark weekends free/busy) to avoid double-bookings.
- Receive direct event booking inquiries from clients for weddings, corporate galas, and private events with 0% agency deductions.

## Key URLs & Sections
- [Artist Portal Home](https://artists.magnevents.in): Overview of artist benefits, verification standards, and login.
- [Artist Registration](https://artists.magnevents.in/register): Direct registration for solo singers, bands, DJs, and instrumentalists.
- [Artist Login](https://artists.magnevents.in/login): Sign-in for registered artists to access their management dashboard.
- [Onboarding Guide](https://artists.magnevents.in/onboarding): 4-step onboarding flow covering profile details, pricing, media showreels, and KYC verification.
- [Main Booking Platform](https://www.magnevents.in): Public-facing client platform showcasing verified live artists.
- [Live Artists Directory](https://www.magnevents.in/artists): Public catalog where approved artists are featured.

## Verification & Trust Requirements
To ensure high-quality live experiences for event hosts, every artist profile is reviewed by human Artist Directors:
1. Genuine live performance video clips (not audio-dubbed studio recordings).
2. Transparent base rates and technical rider specifications.
3. Accurate location and pan-India travel willingness.
4. Professional communication and verified contact information.
